description: Erection of a part two, part single storey rear extension, rear roof dormer extension with rear juliete balcony and side roof dormer extension, installation of replacement front, side and rear windows and other refurbishments to the house, and conversion of the house's existing internal garage space to habitable space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  267PL/D/P/107  Received:  12 July 2023;  267PL/D/P/100; 267PL/D/P/101; 267PL/D/P/103; 267PL/D/EX/105; 267PL/D/P/106  Received:  05 May 2023;  267PL/D/DEMO/100; 267PL/D/DEMO/101; 267PL/D/DEMO/103; 267PL/D/DEMO/104; 267PL/D/DEMO/105; 267PL/D/DEMO/106; 267PL/D/DEMO/107; 267PL/D/DEMOCS/108; 267PL/D/EX/100; 267PL/D/EX/101; 267PL/D/EX/103; 2667PL/D/EX/104; 267PL/D/EX/106; 267PL/D/EX/107; 267PL/D/EXCS/108; 267PL/D/EXSP; 267PL/D/LOC; 267PL/D/P/104; 267PL/D/PCS/108; 267PL/D/PSP  Received:  10 March 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension, rear roof dormer extension and side roof dormer extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The house's conjoined original single storey side projection (attached to No. 269 Popes Lane) and existing single storey side garage extension shall not be sub-divided from and otherwise converted to form a self-contained dwelling that is not an integral part of No. 267 Popes Lane without the approval of the Local Planning Authority.
